referenceConcept.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one background concept for RiceCal's App Store product-page Header, a calorie-tracking app for Asian food. Create a single polished panoramic image in an approximately 21:9 aspect ratio, around 3840 × 1646 if possible. This is background artwork only: no text, lettering, logos, UI, phone mockups, badges, borders, or watermarks. Keep the middle 43% of the width and middle 40% of the height visually calm so a large centered RiceCal wordmark can be added later. Make a clear, elegant composition with a distinctive artistic point of view, not a collage of unrelated objects. Use restrained detail and a handcrafted editorial feel, appropriate to Apple's simple brand-led product-page header examples. Primary request: a graceful, energetic outdoor movement scene with a runner and a cyclist on a curving park path, both small and confined to the far left and far right areas, with no people or sports equipment blocking the central wordmark area. Contemporary hand-painted editorial illustration, sophisticated simple silhouettes and flowing shapes. Open sunny park, layered green foliage, a hint of a tropical setting, warm ivory sky, muted orange accents and emerald green. Convey everyday wellbeing and activity rather than elite competition. Natural anatomy and casual sports clothes. No stadiums, medals, muscular bodybuilding poses, calorie claims, text or logos.
